BiblicalUsage: Misham is named once, among the sons of Elpaal. Elpaal was a Benjamite whose sons built Ono and Lod with their towns.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe builders are remembered: Misham's name is kept with the towns his family raised, and the work outlasted the man.
